symptom: A page data source `$Order/M.Flag_Account/M.Flag` (or `database from $currentObject/…` with the same path) passes `check` and `exec` writes it, although M.Flag_Account joins Flag and Account and cannot be followed from an Order
cause: resolveAssociationSourceHops checked an author-supplied destination against the association's ends, and that the association exists, but never that the association touches the entity the hop starts from. A derived destination was safe by accident: resolveAssociationDestination finds none when the start is off the association, so only the spelled-out `Assoc/Dest` form slipped through
insight: A destination check alone is not a hop check: an association has two ends, so naming either one passes it from anywhere. Check the START against the ends too, accepting a specialization (Administration.Account over System.User's associations). At check time report only what is provable — walk the start's generalization chain through the script's entities and the loaded models and stay silent at the first entity in neither (System entities are not loaded), the same rule as provablyNotSpecializationOf
